maya chen: FYI customer 'NordicPay' reporting repeated 429s since 01:00 CET even though console shows quota remaining for their token. They sent correlation: console shows ~4.8k tokens available at 01:05 CET, but their app got throttled at 01:03 and 01:08.
raj patel: thanks. any chance this is the usual aggregation lag? which panel are they looking at?
maya chen: quota > Token Usage (per-minute) panel in Console, timezone set to tenant local (Europe/Stockholm). Customer screenshot included.
olivia nguyen: can you paste the exact request_id / tenant id? I can check enforcer logs.
maya chen: tenant=t-nordicpay, request_ids: r_01a, r_01b, r_01c (from their dev logs).
tia lopez: @olivia grabbed enforcer logs for t-nordicpay around 2024-11-03T00:58:00Z..2024-11-03T01:12:00Z and saw multiple rejects with reason=RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED. sample log: ```2024-11-03T01:03:12Z enforcer[t-nordicpay] req=r_01a window_start=2024-11-03T01:00:00Z window_end=2024-11-03T02:00:00Z tokens=1200 limit=1000 result=REJECT```
raj patel: console panel query is doing GROUP BY to tenant-local minute buckets. enforcer uses fixed UTC hourly windows for rate calc. if the console shifts the bucket boundaries by local tz, you can see a mismatch at the hour boundary.
maya chen: that would explain the screenshot — we saw console timestamped 02:03+01:00 showing usage under threshold, while enforcer log says window already had >limit.
olivia nguyen: confirmed. enforcer's window_start/stop in logs are in UTC and the enforcer code computes sliding windows aligned to UTC hour boundaries (policy). Console queries materialized views with tenant timezone offset applied, so the chart labels are offset and the displayed per-window totals don't align.
tia lopez: repro steps I ran: 1) issue synthetic requests that cross the hour boundary in CET (01:59:30 -> 02:00:30 CET). 2) check enforcer logs (UTC) and console panel (Europe/Stockholm). result: enforcer rejects at UTC window 01:00-02:00 which covers CET 02:00-03:00 while console showed tokens in previous local window.
maya chen: customer hit this during DST transition yesterday — could be worse when clocks change.
eng-sre: adding quantitative proof. Query against metrics-store (ClickHouse): ```SELECT toStartOfHour(time, 'UTC') as w, sum(tokens) FROM rate_events WHERE tenant='t-nordicpay' AND time >= '2024-11-03 00:00:00' AND time < '2024-11-03 03:00:00' GROUP BY w ORDER BY w;``` returned windows with heavy write at 2024-11-03 01:00:00Z. Console panel had equivalent query but with `toStartOfHour(time, 'Europe/Stockholm')` which pushed that sum into a different labeled hour.
raj patel: immediate mitigation options?
olivia nguyen: 1) tell support to warn customers about timezone mismatch (short term). 2) Quick UI change: display both UTC and tenant-local window boundaries on the panel (patch). 3) Longer: change console aggregation to align displayed windows to enforcement semantics (UTC) or add an explicit dropdown for "Align to enforcement windows".
tia lopez: created internal ticket INF-12781 with traces + repro steps + logs. assigned to eng-infra for console query change.
maya chen: support reply draft to customer: "We're investigating; root cause is display bucket alignment difference between Console (tenant timezone) and Enforcement (UTC). Enforcement enforces UTC-aligned windows; your requests were counted in the UTC window that crossed the local hour boundary. We'll provide a fix and a short-term workaround (use UTC panel or shift request timing)." Thoughts?
raj patel: looks good. add suggestion: rotate their burst into off-peak or request increased burst limit while we patch.
olivia nguyen: I've attached trace links and the PR branch: https://git.internal/redwood/console/+/branches/INF-12781/align-windows (WIP).
eng-sre: also FYI quota-bot shows no ingestion lag for that tenant (latency < 3s), so this is strictly window alignment not delayed metrics.
quota-bot: ACTION: ticket INF-12781 created, priority=P2, stakeholders=[eng-infra, eng-runtime, support].
maya chen: thanks everyone. I'll send the customer the draft and include the temporary workaround. Follow-up: eng-infra to evaluate UX options; eng-runtime to confirm no enforcement behavior change required.
olivia nguyen: plan for patch: change Console aggregation to call ClickHouse with `toStartOfHour(time, 'UTC')` for rate panels OR add a toggle — will propose in PR by EOD.
tia lopez: leaving notes in INF-12781 about DST edge cases and to add unit tests that simulate TZ offsets.
raj patel: great. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:
maya chen: closing the loop in support ticket now. will post updates here when PR lands. :white_check_mark:
